question: What are the respective sizes of the knobs at the base and tip of the handle?
premises: Knobs are to be placed at the base and tip of the handle.
Two different finger measures are specified.
The measures are to be applied in order.
inference: Therefore, the knobs at the base and tip should be three and four finger-widths respectively.
plain_english: At the base and tip of the handle, the knobs should be three and four finger-widths respectively.
